headline: Zelda: Ocarina of Time on Switch 2!
title: Zelda Ocarina of Time Remake Switch 2 Release Date November 5 | Gaming News
video_script: Big news, Zelda fans! A remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 on November fifth, twenty twenty six. The Nintendo 64 classic gets brand new visuals, fully voiced cutscenes and an orchestral soundtrack. The digital version costs fifty nine ninety nine, and the physical edition sixty nine ninety nine. Will you play it? Comment below!
